name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Blue Dream
description:
Mad Labs 2G Disposable Vape — Blue Dream

Meet your new daytime go-to. The Mad Labs Blue Dream disposable packs a full 2 grams into a sleek, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Blue Dream is a beloved sativa-dominant hybrid, born from crossing sweet Blueberry with energizing Haze. Expect a smooth, berry-forward flavor with soft herbal undertones on every pull. The effect leans bright and uplifting, delivering a mellow, clear-headed lift balanced by gentle full-body ease — making it a favorite for creativity, conversation, and staying productive without feeling weighed down.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Blue Dream flavor — sweet blueberry meets smooth haze
Balanced hybrid effects — uplifting yet relaxed, ideal for daytime

Smooth flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Blue Dream is ready whenever you are.
